options.content: This dashboard displays the usage of LLMs and VectorDBs, tracking OpenTelemetry Traces and Metrics sent using [OpenLIT](https://github.com/openlit/openlit)

panels.description: This panel displays the total number of successful requests made to the GenAI system. A successful request is one that is completed without errors, indicating seamless operation and effective utilization of the GenAI service. Tracking this helps in understanding the reliability and performance of the GenAI system.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(SpanId)
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != ''

panels.title: Total GenAI Requests

panels.description: This panel displays the ranking of GenAI models based on their usage frequency. It identifies which models are most popular or in-demand, providing insights into user preferences and operational trends. Analyzing this helps in resource allocation, optimizing model availability, and understanding which GenAI features are driving usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as Model,
  uniqExact(SpanId) as Usage
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != ''
GROUP BY Model

panels.title: Top GenAI Models by Usage

panels.description: This panel displays the ranking of tools used by GenAI models, based on their usage frequency. It identifies which tools are most popular or in-demand, providing insights into user preferences and operational trends. Analyzing this helps in resource allocation, optimizing model availability, and understanding which GenAI features are driving usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toolName as Tool, count() as Usage
FROM (
  SELECT arrayJoin(extractAll(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.tool_calls'], '.*''name'':\\s''(.+?)''.*')) as toolName
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.tool_calls'] != ''
  AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.tool_calls'] LIKE '[{%'
)
GROUP BY toolName

panels.title: Top GenAI Tools by Usage

panels.description: This panel displays the distribution of GenAI requests across different platforms such as OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, etc. It shows where requests are being sent, giving insights into platform popularity and usage patterns. Monitoring this helps in understanding platform preferences, and it can guide strategic decisions for integration or diversification of GenAI services.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] as Platform,
  uniqExact(SpanId) as Requests
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY Platform

panels.title: GenAI Requests by Platform

panels.description: This panel displays the breakdown of GenAI requests by type, such as Chat, Embedding, Image, Audio, and Fine Tuning. It reveals the diversity in usage, highlighting which types of requests are most common. Understanding this distribution assists in optimizing resources for the most demanded services and planning for future needs based on usage trends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] as Type,
  uniqExact(SpanId) as Requests
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != ''
GROUP BY Type

panels.title: GenAI Requests by Type

panels.description: This panel displays the distribution of GenAI requests based on the application. It shows where the requests are being utilized, providing a clear picture of operational focus and deployment strategies. Tracking this helps in aligning resources appropriately and optimizing the performance across different environments.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  ServiceName,
  uniqExact(SpanId) as Requests
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY ServiceName

panels.title: GenAI Requests by Application

panels.description: This panel displays the distribution of GenAI requests based on the environment, such as production, development, testing, etc. It shows where the requests are being utilized, providing a clear picture of operational focus and deployment strategies. Tracking this helps in aligning resources appropriately and optimizing the performance across different environments.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  SpanAttributes['deployment.environment'] as Environment,
  uniqExact(SpanId) as Requests
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['deployment.environment'] != ''
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY Environment

panels.title: GenAI Requests by Environment

panels.description: This panel displays the Avg total tokens consumed by GenAI requests, providing a direct measure of usage. Monitoring this helps in assessing the demand on GenAI services and guiding resource allocation or optimization strategies.
panels.title: Avg Total Tokens

panels.description: This panel displays the Avg number of prompt tokens consumed by GenAI requests, providing a direct measure of usage. Monitoring this helps in assessing the demand on GenAI services and guiding resource allocation or optimization strategies.
panels.title: Avg Prompt Tokens

panels.description: This panel displays the average number of completion tokens consumed by GenAI requests, providing a direct measure of usage. Monitoring this helps in assessing the demand on GenAI services and guiding resource allocation or optimization strategies.
panels.title: Avg Completion Tokens

panels.description: This panel displays the total cost incurred from using GenAI models. It reflects the financial impact of operational activities, offering insights into budgetary allocation and efficiency. Tracking this helps in effective cost management and financial planning for GenAI usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost']))
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost'] != ''

panels.title: Total Usage Cost

panels.description: This panel displays the average cost per use of the GenAI models and related services. It provides insights into the cost-effectiveness of interactions with GenAI, helping to identify trends in expense per operation. Monitoring this assists in optimizing budget allocation and improving cost efficiency in GenAI utilization.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost']))
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost'] != ''

panels.title: Avg Usage Cost

panels.description: This panel displays an average LLM response duration graph. It provides a visual representation of the GenAI response timing. Analyzing this graph helps in assessing GenAI performance and guiding strategic decisions for efficient resource utilization.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(Timestamp) as t,
  avg(Duration) as Duration
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Average Duration

panels.description: This panel displays a comparative graph showing the average number of tokens consumed for completions and prompts against the average usage cost. It provides a visual representation of the relationship between the volume of data processed (in tokens) and the financial implications of using GenAI services. Analyzing this comparison helps in assessing cost-effectiveness and guiding strategic decisions for efficient resource utilization.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(Timestamp) as t,
  avg(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) as "Avg Prompt Tokens"
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(Timestamp) as t,
  avg(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) as "Avg Completion Tokens"
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(Timestamp) as t,
  avg(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost'])) as "Avg Usage Cost"
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system'] != ''
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Average Token Consumption vs. Average Usage Cost Comparison

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(Timestamp) as Time,
  TraceId,
  SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.id'] as ReqID,
  arrayJoin(arrayMap(x -> x['gen_ai.prompt'], Events.Attributes)) as Prompt
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND Prompt != ''
ORDER By Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  toString(Timestamp) as Time,
  TraceId,
  arrayJoin(arrayMap(x -> x['exception.type'], Events.Attributes)) as Type,
  arrayJoin(arrayMap(x -> x['exception.message'], Events.Attributes)) as Message,
  arrayJoin(arrayMap(x -> x['exception.stacktrace'], Events.Attributes)) as Exception
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
AND Exception != ''
ORDER By Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Count of all spans in otel_traces for the selected time range (no gen_ai filters). If this is zero, OTLP is not reaching ClickHouse or there was no traffic. If this is positive but GenAI panels are empty, spans lack OpenLIT gen_ai.* attributes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS trace_rows FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.title: Diagnostics: span rows (any span, no GenAI filter)
